title: Sad!! Missing the best in the box.
text: The July box was our first and while the products we did receive were GREAT, we were missing the one product that would have made the $15.00 a month worth it. HA! Missing the La Roche POSAY Active C10. The best product in the mix and it was obviously not going to fit in that box they sent so I imagine I have been Bait and Switched a bit so that is a huge disappointment for the money. I get more with “gifts” from other main cosmetic companies than this box so far. I hope August is better and actually contains what is advertised or we will be at an end with this subscription.
label: neutral
